name: @iflow-mcp/kilo-org_kilo-dev-mcp-server

tools.name: translate_i18n_key
tools.description: Translate a specific key or keys from English to other languages

paths.description: Array of paths to translate in English locale. For core/webview targets, use format "filename:keyPath" (e.g., "kilocode:lowCreditWarning.nice"). For package target, use the direct key path (e.g., "command.generateCommitMessage.title") - namespace prefixes like "package:" will be automatically stripped.

workspaceRoot.description: Root path of the workspace/repository (used to locate locale files)

useCurrentFile.description: Use the currently open file as context for translation (optional)

targetLocales.description: List of locale codes to translate to (empty for all)

tools.name: move_i18n_key
tools.description: Move a key from one JSON file to another across all locales

workspaceRoot.description: Root path of the workspace/repository (used to locate locale files)

newKey.description: Optional new key name for the destination

workspaceRoot.description: Root path of the workspace/repository (used to locate locale files)

tools.name: remove_i18n_keys
tools.description: Remove specified keys from all locale files across all languages

workspaceRoot.description: Root path of the workspace/repository (used to locate locale files)

tools.name: sort_i18n_keys
tools.description: Sort the keys in all locale files based on the English locale structure

workspaceRoot.description: Root path of the workspace/repository (used to locate locale files)

files.description: Optional array of specific file names to sort (e.g., ['kilocode.json', 'tools.json']). If not provided, sorts all files.

tools.name: query_expert_panel
tools.description: Query a panel of LLM experts for opinions on code quality, refactoring suggestions, or architectural decisions

question.description: The specific question or aspect to analyze about the code

language.description: The programming language of the code (optional)

context.description: Additional context about the codebase or requirements (optional)

models.description: Specific models to use (optional, defaults to a predefined set of models)

tools.name: launch_dev_extension
tools.description: Launch a VSCode extension in development mode with a test prompt

extensionPath.description: Path to the extension development directory

prompt.description: The prompt to execute in the extension

launchDir.description: Directory to open Visual Studio Code in and write the prompt to

tools.name: stop_dev_extension
tools.description: Stop a VSCode extension test by session ID or the currently running test

sessionId.description: ID of the session to stop. If not provided, stops the current session.

tools.name: write_prompt_file
tools.description: Write a prompt file without launching VSCode (for debugging)

launchDir.description: Directory to write the prompt file to

prompt.description: The prompt to write to the file
